job.job_title: AI/LLM QA Engineer - Python & AI Quality Engineering
job.job_description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated AI/LLM QA Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based test automation and LLM evaluation techniques. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in testing AI/ML or LLM-based systems, ensuring quality, reliability, and performance of intelligent applications.

You will play a key role in building AI Quality Engineering frameworks, validating LLM outputs, and integrating testing pipelines within modern cloud and orchestration ecosystems.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and execute automated test frameworks for AI/LLM systems using Python.
Perform LLM evaluation and validation using:

o Semantic similarity

o Embeddings-based scoring

o Regression testing strategies for model outputs

Build and maintain test suites using Pytest, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, or Behave.
Conduct API testing and integration testing using libraries like boto3, requests, etc.
Generate rich test reports using tools like pytest-html and enable parallel execution via pytest-xdist.
Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to define evaluation benchmarks and test datasets.
Implement end-to-end validation of AI workflows, including orchestration frameworks.
Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins).
Monitor system performance and quality metrics using tools like Grafana.
Manage defect tracking, test cases, and reporting using Jira and X-Ray.



Mandatory Skills

Programming & Automation

Strong hands-on experience with Python
Experience with:

o boto3, requests

o pytest, pytest-html, pytest-xdist

Knowledge of testing frameworks:

o Pytest / TestNG / JUnit / Cucumber / Behave

AI/LLM Testing Expertise

Experience in Software QA/Testing for AI/ML or LLM-based systems
Strong knowledge of:

o LLM evaluation techniques (semantic similarity, embeddings)

o Regression testing for AI outputs

o Prompt/output validation

Orchestration Frameworks

Experience with at least one:

LangChain / LangGraph
LlamaIndex
DSPy
OpenAI Assistants / Actions
Similar AI orchestration tools

DevOps & QA Tools

CI/CD Tools: GitLab, Jenkins
Monitoring: Grafana
Test & Issue Tracking: Jira, X-Ray
Exposure to AI Quality Engineering practices



Secondary Skills (Nice to Have)

Experience with AWS and data platforms:

o SageMaker, Redshift, Athena

Databases:

o SQL Server, Teradata, Aurora DB

Data tools:

o Alteryx, Data Lake technologies

Understanding of data pipelines and large-scale data processing
